title: Workbench layout definition
description: One named workbench layout (_data/workbench/layouts/<id>.json, REQ-007 W05/W16, ADR-016). schema_version 2: eligibility moved from the slot to the panel — each panel declares the slots it may occupy, and the file carries a default total assignment (every panel assigned to exactly one of its own eligible slots) plus the default visible panel for any slot a default assignment leaves holding more than one panel. This schema asserts structural shape only; the relational invariants (eligible_slots/default_assignment/default_visible_panel/grid.areas all referring to real slots and panels, and the assignment being total and eligible) are asserted directly against the parsed JSON by test/test_workbench_layout_schema.py, which JSON Schema alone cannot express.

schema_version.description: Bumped from 1 by the REQ-007 W16 delta that moved eligibility from the slot to the panel.

default_assignment.description: panel_id -> slot_id, a total mapping over every panel declared in `panels`.

default_visible_panel.description: slot_id -> panel_id, for slots whose default assignment gives them more than one panel.
